final: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_type), scored AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average FROM scored WHERE share > average_share
